_purpose: The customer flow's title and ordered step titles — the ONE source read by both the spec (apps/web/e2e/customer-flow.spec.ts) and the report gate (apps/web/scripts/assert-e2e-report.mjs), so the gate can refuse a report whose test is not this flow or whose steps did not all run.
title: a new customer signs up, onboards, creates a location and a scout, runs it, sees the opportunity it produced, and signs out
steps: 1. sign-up establishes the customer session and context
1a. the customer creates the workspace the product asks for (Settings → Workspaces → New)
4. the customer creates a scout for that location
5. running that scout executes it and produces opportunities
6. the customer sees the opportunity this run produced
7. sign-out ends the session and protected routes expose nothing
